integrity: All quantitative inequalities follow from explicitly identified finite-dimensional operator identities; numerical checks are supporting finite evidence, not universal proofs; independent validation remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Single-particle finite connected graphs, homogeneous positive bond dissipation, matched Peierls phases, and onsite Hermitian perturbations only; no thermodynamic efficiency or many-body guarantee. The graph-dependent bounds are nonoptimal numerical constants and do not establish a graph-size-uniform perturbation theorem.
title: Graph-gap preparation and quadratic disorder fidelity for bond-dissipative quantum batteries
